title: Puharich's lecture admitting work for the CIA
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Puharich's lecture admitting work for the CIA, about 1995 at parapsychology conferences, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I worked for this part of the CIA. My boss was the guy who was directly involved with all the hypnosis mind manipulation stuff.

plain: An unnamed guest researcher on the podcast of host Jesse Michels says that Andrija Puharich, a scientist interested in psychic matters, gave a lecture at a parapsychology conference, a meeting of people who study psychic abilities, around 1995. According to the guest, Puharich said there that he had worked for a part of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, and that his boss was directly involved in hypnosis and mind manipulation, which if true would be a first-hand admission of that link.
